en.content: The correct order of the first ionization enthalpies is :

options.content: Ti < Mn < Zn < Ni
Zn < Ni < Mn < Ti
Mn < Ti < Zn < Ni
Ti < Mn < Ni < Zn

en.explanation:
In a period, from left to right ionization enthalpy increses.

So in period 4, correct order for those 4 elements is

Ti < Mn < Ni < Zn

Exceptions in period 4 are

(1) V(Vanadium) < Ti(Titanium)

(2) Ni(Titanium) < Co(Cobalt)

(3) Ga(Gallium) < Zn(Zinc)

(4) Se(Selenium) < As(Arsenic)
